emailAdmin.title: Email server
emailAdmin.subtitle: The mail server {brand} sends verification emails and sign-in codes through. Works with any SMTP provider, such as Amazon SES, SendGrid, Mailgun, Gmail or your own relay. Changes apply immediately, with no restart.
emailAdmin.statusLive: Email delivery is on: verification emails and codes are being sent through this server.
emailAdmin.statusOff: Email delivery is off. Emails are written to the API server log instead of being sent, so people who register will not receive their verification link.
emailAdmin.enabledHint: Needs a server host and a sender address. Use "Send a test email" below to check the settings before switching this on.

emailAdmin.usernameHint: Leave blank only if your relay accepts mail without signing in.
emailAdmin.passwordHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again after saving.
emailAdmin.senderHint: Use a sender address on a domain your provider has verified (SPF/DKIM), or emails may land in spam or be rejected.
emailAdmin.testHint: Sends a real email using the saved settings - even while delivery is switched off - and shows the mail server's reply if it fails.
emailAdmin.testSaveFirst: Save your changes before sending a test.
emailAdmin.testNeedsServer: Save a server host and a sender address first.
emailAdmin.requestAlertsHint: One or more addresses, separated by commas. Leave empty to alert every active admin and staff account that has an email address.

brandingAdmin.regionalNote: Dates and times are shown in Sri Lanka time and amounts in LKR.

correct.buttonHint: Fix work that already happened or is already billed

An invoice or pay statement the client or caregiver has seen is never rewritten: an unpaid invoice can be replaced by a corrected copy, and any other difference is carried to the next invoice or pay statement.
correct.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. The timesheet shows Tuesday ran until 7 pm
correct.missingHint: Added as done. It must not overlap the caregiver's other shifts.

correct.stale: The correction changed - preview it again before applying.
correct.noDocuments: Nothing on an invoice or pay statement changes.

correct.unbilledPay: On no pay statement yet: {shifts}. The next pay run covering those days picks them up.

action.REPLACE: Void it and make a corrected copy to issue
action.CARRY: Leave it as it is and carry the difference forward
action.REOPEN: Sent back to draft and updated

correct.billedLocked: On an invoice or pay statement - use Correct to change it
correct.settleReason: How was it settled? e.g. refunded in cash

done.REPLACE: voided and replaced by a corrected draft
done.REOPEN: sent back to draft and updated

meaning.PENDING_REVIEW: Newly registered and not yet reviewed by staff. Can sign in and send care requests.
meaning.ACTIVE: Reviewed and in good standing. Can sign in and send care requests.

ACTIVE.title: Activate {name}?
ACTIVE.message: The client will be marked as reviewed and in good standing, and can send care requests.

INACTIVE.title: Mark {name} as inactive?

SUSPENDED.title: Suspend {name}?

adsAdmin.title: Google AdSense
adsAdmin.subtitle: Show Google ads on the public {brand} website to earn from its visitors. Changes apply on the next page load, with no restart.
adsAdmin.statusLive: Ads are on: Google ads are shown on the public landing page, search and caregiver profiles.
adsAdmin.statusOff: Ads are off. No ad code is loaded anywhere on the site.
adsAdmin.publisherIdHint: In AdSense under Account > Account information, e.g. ca-pub-0123456789012345. You can also paste the whole AdSense code snippet.
adsAdmin.publisherIdInvalid: That is not an AdSense publisher ID. It looks like ca-pub- followed by 16 digits.
adsAdmin.enabled: Show ads on the public website
adsAdmin.enabledHint: Loads the AdSense code on public pages. Turn on Auto ads for this site in AdSense to let Google place ads automatically.
adsAdmin.enabledNeedsId: Enter your publisher ID before switching ads on.
adsAdmin.unitsHint: To put an ad in a fixed spot, create a display ad unit in AdSense and paste its data-ad-slot number here. Leave a field empty for no ad in that spot.

slotHint.home: Shown between the 'How it works' and gallery sections of the landing page.
slotHint.search: Shown under the list of caregivers on the search page.
slotHint.profile: Shown below a caregiver's public profile.

adsAdmin.slotInvalid: Enter only the digits from data-ad-slot, e.g. 1234567890.
adsAdmin.adsTxtHint: AdSense checks this line to confirm the site is yours. It is published automatically at {url} while ads are on - there is nothing to upload.
adsAdmin.adsTxtEmpty: Appears here once a publisher ID is entered.
adsAdmin.whereShown: Only on the public landing page, the search page and public caregiver profiles.
adsAdmin.whereNever: Never in this staff app, on sign-in or registration pages, or in a client's or caregiver's own account.
adsAdmin.whereConsent: Serving visitors in the EEA, UK or Switzerland? Google requires a certified consent message - set one up in AdSense under Privacy & messaging.
adsAdmin.saveError: Could not save the ads settings. Please try again.

analyticsAdmin.title: Google Analytics
analyticsAdmin.subtitle: Measure visits to the public {brand} website with Google Analytics 4. Changes apply on the next page load, with no restart.
analyticsAdmin.statusLive: Google Analytics is on: visits to the public website's signed-out pages are reported to your Analytics property.
analyticsAdmin.statusOff: Google Analytics is off. No Google tag is loaded and nothing is sent to Google.
analyticsAdmin.measurementIdHint: In Google Analytics under Admin > Data streams > your web stream, e.g. G-AB12CD34EF. You can also paste the whole Google tag snippet.
analyticsAdmin.measurementIdInvalid: That is not a Google Analytics 4 measurement ID. It starts with G- (older UA- IDs no longer work).
analyticsAdmin.enabledHint: Loads the Google tag on the public website and reports a page view on each page visited.
analyticsAdmin.enabledNeedsId: Enter your measurement ID before switching Google Analytics on.
analyticsAdmin.setupIntro: In Google Analytics, open Admin > Data streams > your web stream > Enhanced measurement and:
analyticsAdmin.setupHistory: Turn off 'Page changes based on browser history events' - the site reports its own page views, and this would count each one twice.
analyticsAdmin.setupSiteSearch: Turn off 'Site search' - search terms can describe a person's health, and must not be sent to Google.
analyticsAdmin.setupCheck: To check it works, open Reports > Realtime and visit the public website.
analyticsAdmin.whereShown: Only the public website's signed-out pages: the landing page, search, caregiver profiles and the sign-in and sign-up pages.
analyticsAdmin.whereNever: Never this staff app, a client's account pages or the caregiver portal.
analyticsAdmin.whereQuery: Addresses are sent without their query string, so search terms and sign-in links never reach Google.
analyticsAdmin.whereConsent: Serving visitors in the EEA, UK or Switzerland? You may need a cookie consent banner before measuring them.
analyticsAdmin.saveError: Could not save the analytics settings. Please try again.

aiAdmin.title: AI
aiAdmin.subtitle: The model behind AI Search on the public site, caregiver suggestions on requests, and the staff assistant.
aiAdmin.statusOff: AI is off. Search, matching and every staff page work without it.
aiAdmin.enabledHint: Master switch. Turning it off stops every AI feature immediately.
aiAdmin.publicSearch: AI Search on the public site
aiAdmin.publicSearchHint: Visitors describe the care they need in their own words; the AI fills in the search form for them to check, then orders the matching caregivers.
aiAdmin.staffMatchingHint: Reads a request's care needs and message, and orders suggested caregivers. Without it, suggestions use the rule-based ranking.
aiAdmin.assistantHint: A chat for staff to work requests and bookings. It can look things up; every change waits for staff approval.

baseUrlHint.OLLAMA: The Ollama server's address, e.g. http://localhost:11434. Use a model that supports tool calling (e.g. qwen2.5 or llama3.1) for the assistant.
baseUrlHint.OPENAI_COMPATIBLE: The base URL including /v1, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1. Works with vLLM, LM Studio, OpenRouter and Ollama's /v1.

aiAdmin.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
aiAdmin.apiKeyHintOllama: Not needed for a local Ollama server; set one if yours sits behind an authenticating proxy.
aiAdmin.temperatureHint: Lower is more consistent; 0.1-0.3 suits search and operations. Leave blank to use the model's default - some newer models (e.g. recent Claude and OpenAI reasoning models) don't accept a temperature, and it is then left out automatically.
aiAdmin.timeoutHint: If the model takes longer, search falls back to the normal order.
aiAdmin.poolHint: Only this many of the hard-filtered matches are sent to the model; the rest keep the rule-based order.
aiAdmin.promptsHint: Added to the built-in instructions - for house rules, not to replace them.
aiAdmin.searchPrompt: For AI Search and caregiver suggestions
aiAdmin.privacyTitle: What is sent to the model
aiAdmin.privacy: AI Search sends the visitor's description and the anonymous public profile of each candidate (no names or contact details). Suggestions and the assistant send names, care needs and request or booking details, but never phone numbers, emails, addresses or ID numbers. Use a provider whose data terms you accept, or a local Ollama model to keep everything on your own servers.
aiAdmin.saveError: Could not save the settings. Please try again.
aiAdmin.testHint: Sends two small requests with the saved settings - a reply and a tool call - even while AI is off.
aiAdmin.testSaveFirst: Save your changes first - the test uses the saved settings.
aiAdmin.testFailed: The model could not be used.
aiAdmin.testTools: Tool calling works - the assistant can use this model.
aiAdmin.testNoTools: This model did not call a tool - choose one that supports tool calling for the assistant.

suggestions.ruleRanked: Ordered by the matching rules for:

map.summaryDistrictOther: {count} matching caregivers live or work in or near {place} district

map.noLocation: This client has no district or city on record, so distances cannot be shown.
map.mapLabel: Map of matching caregivers near the client

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.intro: Ask about requests and bookings, find caregivers, or have it prepare changes. Nothing changes until you approve it.
assistant.openSettings: Turn it on in Settings › AI
assistant.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? Changes already approved stay as they are.
assistant.placeholder: Ask the assistant… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
assistant.sendFailed: The message could not be sent. Please try again.
assistant.decideFailed: That could not be saved. Please try again.
assistant.disclaimer: The assistant can be wrong - check each change before approving it.

starters.unmatched: Show open requests with no caregiver yet
starters.mine: Summarise the requests assigned to me

international.title: Overseas
international.subtitle: Employers abroad and their enquiries, the vacancy board, interviews and offers, placements and welfare, and caregivers' shared profiles.

enquiries.search: Search by reference, organisation, contact or email

detail.notFound: This enquiry could not be found.
detail.askedAbout: Sent from the shared profile of
detail.feeHint: Record the fee agreed with the employer. Caregivers are never charged a placement fee.
detail.notePlaceholder: Calls, shortlisted caregivers, next steps. Never shown to the employer or a caregiver.

profiles.hint: Check exactly what will be public: the photo should be the caregiver and suitable for employers, and the headline and introduction must not include contact details. Rejecting asks the caregiver to change it - say what.
profiles.contactWarning: This text may include a phone number, email or social media handle. Contact must go through staff.
profiles.notePlaceholder: Note to the caregiver (required when asking for changes)
profiles.noteRequired: Tell the caregiver what to change.

training.hint: Programmes caregivers can sign up for. Mark someone Completed only when they have finished - it appears on their shared profile.
training.translationHint: English is required. Sinhala and Tamil show the English text until they are filled in.
training.englishRequired: The English title and description are required.
training.passMarkHint: Leave empty if there is no final assessment.
training.passMarkIs: Pass mark: {n}. A certificate needs a score at or above it.
training.revokeReason: Why? (shown to anyone who checks it)

employers.hint: Verify that an organisation is real and recruiting lawfully before it can ask for interviews. Rejecting or suspending tells the employer why - say what.
employers.notePlaceholder: Note to the employer (required to reject or suspend)
employers.confirmFirst: The employer must confirm their email address before they can be verified.

pool.hint: Every listed caregiver who is open to working abroad, most ready first. Only those with a live shared profile can be put forward to an employer.
pool.search: Search by name or registration number

interviews.hint: Employers who asked to interview a caregiver. Contact the caregiver, arrange the interview, then set the date on the enquiry.
interviews.title: Interviews
interviews.instructionsPlaceholder: Who joins, what to have ready...
interviews.emailed: The employer and the caregiver are both emailed the time, in Sri Lanka time and UTC. Their own screens show it in their time zone.

candidates.title: Caregivers on this enquiry
candidates.hint: The employer sees each caregiver only through their shared profile, with the status and your message below.
candidates.notLive: Profile no longer shared - hidden from the employer
candidates.messageToEmployer: Message to the employer (shown to them)
candidates.placedHint: Remember to mark the enquiry Placed and record the placement fee below.
candidates.sameCountry: Only caregivers who want to work in this country
candidates.choose: Choose a caregiver with a live shared profile
candidates.noneAvailable: No caregivers with a live shared profile match
candidates.messagePlaceholder: Optional message to the employer, e.g. why this caregiver fits
candidates.proposeHint: The employer and the caregiver are both told by email.

vacancies.hint: Vacancies employers post wait here for review before they go on the public board. Read each one's applicants and put forward those who fit - they become candidates on the enquiry.
vacancies.notePlaceholder: Note to the employer (needed to send it back)
vacancies.noteRequired: Tell the employer what to change.
vacancies.needsLiveProfile: Their shared profile must be live before they can be put forward.
vacancies.noneOnEnquiry: No vacancy posted for this enquiry.

placements.hint: Caregivers hired through the platform. Call each one when a check-in falls due - overdue check-ins are in red and in the daily email.
placements.guarantee: Free replacement if it ends before {date}
placements.noCheckins: Check-ins are scheduled once you record the arrival date.
placements.notePlaceholder: What they said, anything to follow up
placements.urgentHint: Saving this alerts every staff member by email.
placements.setFeeFirst: Set the fee below to raise the invoice.
placements.arrivalNeeded: Add the arrival date to mark them as working.

invoices.hint: Placement-fee invoices to overseas employers. Card payments arrive by themselves; record bank transfers here.
invoices.employerCanPay: The employer can see this invoice in their account and pay it by card.
invoices.employerSees: The employer can see this invoice in their account; it can't be paid by card in this currency.
invoices.noAccount: This employer has no account - send them the invoice yourself.
invoices.issueHint: Issuing numbers the invoice and emails it to {email}. It can't be changed afterwards.
invoices.issueNoEmail: Issuing numbers the invoice. There is no email address to send it to.

expiring.hint: Passports and documents that have expired or will soon. Caregivers are emailed at 90 and 30 days and once after; call the ones abroad first.

offers.hint: Job offers employers signed. Read each one before the caregiver sees it: send it on, or return it to the employer with a note.
offers.acceptedHint: Accepted. Mark the candidate Placed on the enquiry to start the placement and its departure checklist.
offers.reviewHint: Check the pay against the vacancy and the law where the job is, and that nothing is missing. Then send it, or return it with a note.
offers.notePlaceholder: Optional when sending; needed when returning - what should the employer change?

welfare.hint: Caregivers abroad telling us something is wrong. SOS and urgent reports are emailed to every staff member - call the caregiver first, then reply here.
welfare.replyHint: The caregiver is emailed that we replied. The first reply marks the report as acknowledged.

results.hint: Test results caregivers added. Check each against the original before verifying: only verified results count towards readiness and show on talent profiles.
results.title: Name of the test

journey.title: Departure
journey.notePlaceholder: Where to go, what to bring
journey.contactHint: The caregiver sees all of this and keeps their contact abroad up to date. The employer sees none of it.
journey.openReports: {n} welfare report(s) not closed - open Welfare

reports.funnelNote: Counted when each step happened in the range. The percentage is against the step before.
reports.demandNote: Enquiries, vacancies and roles in the range, against caregivers open to work there now. Red: more roles than caregivers.

edit.title: Edit enquiry
edit.hint: Correct what the employer sent, or link the enquiry to their account. Only what you change is saved, and every edit is recorded in the audit log.
edit.emailHint: Earlier enquiries are linked to an employer account by this email when the account is verified.
edit.noAccount: Not linked to an employer account
edit.accountHint: Link it to the employer's account so it shows in their employer area. It can't be moved once offers, vacancies or placements belong to that account.

dataTransfer.title: Import & export
dataTransfer.subtitle: Download caregivers and clients as a spreadsheet, or add many at once from one.
dataTransfer.exportPrivacy: The file holds personal details (NIC, phone numbers, addresses). Every export is recorded in the audit log.
dataTransfer.step1: Download the template. It has every column and an example row to replace.
dataTransfer.step3: Upload the file and check it. Nothing is saved until you confirm the import.
dataTransfer.guideDates: Dates as YYYY-MM-DD (or DD/MM/YYYY). Format phone and NIC columns as text so the spreadsheet keeps leading zeros.
dataTransfer.guideLocation: District and city are matched by name in English, Sinhala or Tamil; a name that isn't found is left blank and flagged.
dataTransfer.ignoredColumns: Columns not in the template were ignored: {columns}
dataTransfer.importHint: Rows with errors or duplicates are skipped. Fix them in the file and import it again later.
dataTransfer.nothingToImport: No rows can be imported yet. Fix the errors below and check the file again.
dataTransfer.noProblems: Nothing to look at - every row is fine.

issues.duplicateFile: Same person as row {row} in this file.
issues.notFound: {column} "{value}" wasn't found, so it was left blank.
issues.needsEmail: Email can't be the preferred contact without an email address.
issues.needsContact: Give an email address or a phone number.
issues.duplicateBare: Already on the platform ({column} is in use).

caregivers.exportHint: One row per caregiver, with skills, languages and total years of experience. Choose filters, or leave them empty for everyone.
caregivers.searchPlaceholder: Name, registration no., phone or NIC
caregivers.step2: Fill in one caregiver per row. Keep the header row as it is.
caregivers.guideDuplicates: A row whose NIC, passport, primary phone or registration number matches an existing caregiver is skipped, never overwritten.
caregivers.guideResult: Imported caregivers start as Draft with a new registration number, ready for documents and verification.

clients.exportHint: One row per client, with who the care is for and what they need. Choose filters, or leave them empty for everyone.
clients.step2: Fill in one client per row, with an email address or a phone number (or both).
clients.guideDuplicates: A row whose email address or phone number already belongs to anyone on the platform is skipped.
clients.guideResult: Imported clients get a client account with no password. Those with a phone number sign in on the WhatsApp login page with a code sent to that number.

passwordHelp.title: Password
passwordHelp.introHas: Signs in with an email address and password. If they've forgotten it, email them a link to choose a new one.
passwordHelp.introNone: No password yet. Email them a link to set one, so they can sign in with their email address.
passwordHelp.sendLinkHint: To {email}. They choose their own password; the link lasts 24 hours and confirms the address.
passwordHelp.setPasswordHint: For someone who can't use email. Tell them the password; they can change it after signing in.
passwordHelp.auditNote: Recorded in the audit log (never the password).
passwordHelp.linkSent: A reset link was sent to {email}. It works until {time}.
passwordHelp.passwordSet: The password for {email} was set, and they were signed out everywhere.
passwordHelp.shownOnce: Shown only now - give it to them in person or by phone, not by email.
passwordHelp.confirmLinkBody: We'll email {email} a link to choose a new password. Their current password keeps working until they do.
passwordHelp.confirmSetBody: The current password for {email} stops working straight away and they're signed out on every device.
passwordHelp.noEmail: This account has no email address, so it can't use a password. It signs in with WhatsApp or Google/Microsoft/Facebook. Add an email address first if they need a password.
passwordHelp.accountInactive: This account is deactivated, so it can't sign in until it is activated again.

training.title: Training
training.deleteProgrammeBody: "{title}" will be removed. A programme that anyone has signed up for can't be deleted - make it inactive instead.
training.removeSignUpBody: {name} will be taken off this programme, as if they never signed up. To keep the record, mark them Withdrawn instead.

newEnquiry.title: Record an enquiry
newEnquiry.hint: For an enquiry that came in by phone, email or in person. It starts In progress, with no alert to staff, and opens once saved. Only record an employer who asked to be contacted.

deleteEnquiry.title: Delete enquiry {reference}?
deleteEnquiry.body: It will be removed for good. An enquiry with candidates, vacancies, offers, placements or invoices can't be deleted - close it instead.

employer.emailHint: Changing it changes the address they sign in with.
employer.sendLink: Email them a link to set a password
employer.sendLinkHint: Valid for 24 hours. Leave it off to send one later.
employer.createdLinkSent: The employer account was created, and a link to set a password was sent to {email}.
employer.deleteBody: The account and its sign-in will be removed for good. An employer with enquiries, vacancies, offers, placements or invoices can't be deleted - suspend it instead.

candidate.removeBody: Their interviews for this enquiry go too, and a vacancy application they came from goes back to Applied. Not possible once there is an offer or a placement - mark them Not proceeding instead.

vacancy.deleteBody: It will be removed from the board and from here for good. A vacancy with applications can't be deleted - close it instead.

offer.deleteBody: For an offer made by mistake. It disappears for the employer and the caregiver. An accepted offer is a signed agreement and can't be deleted.

interview.deleteBody: For an interview entered by mistake. A real interview that didn't happen should be marked Cancelled or No-show instead.

placement.deleteBody: For a placement opened by mistake. Its check-ins and departure checklist go too, and the candidate goes back to Selected. Not possible once there is an invoice or a welfare report - record how it ended instead.

welfare.deleteBody: The report and its messages will be removed for good. Only resolved reports can be deleted.

problem.title: Give it a title in at least one language.
problem.slot: Choose the part of the day.
problem.times: Enter times as HH:MM, separated by commas, each once.
problem.daysOfWeek: Choose at least one day, or every shift.

editor.textHint: A language left blank shows the text from another language.
editor.empty: No activities yet. Add the first one below.
editor.title: Activity
editor.instructionsPlaceholder: How to do it, what to watch for (optional)

templates.title: Care plan templates
templates.subtitle: Ready-made lists of what a caregiver does on each shift. Apply one to a booking and tailor it to the client - changing a template never changes a plan already made from it.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Create one for each common routine - an elderly client at home, post-operative care, dementia care.
templates.editHint: Staff can apply this template when starting a booking's care plan.
templates.archivedBanner: This template is archived: it can no longer be applied. Plans already made from it are not affected.
templates.name: Template name
templates.careTypesHint: Templates for the booking's kind of care are offered first. Leave all unticked for any.

plan.title: Care plan
plan.none: No care plan on this booking.
plan.pendingFrom: The plan below takes effect from {date}. Until then the earlier version applies (see History).
plan.startHint: Set out what the caregiver does on each shift. The client ticks each item off; anything left unmarked by midnight counts as done.
plan.copyFrom: Copy this client's plan from booking
plan.effectiveHint: Earlier days keep the plan as it was. Earliest possible: {min}.
plan.notesHint: Shown to the caregiver and the client with each day's checklist.

log.title: Care log
log.criticalNotConfirmed: {count} critical not confirmed by the client
log.empty: No shifts with a care plan in these dates.
